_comment: The OpenSSF scanner binary that .github/workflows/pvtr-scan.yml downloads and runs: ossf/pvtr-github-repo-scanner. The release has a checksum but no attestation, so the download is only used when its sha256 equals the value pinned here. Dependabot cannot bump this. To bump it by hand: read the new release's notes and source for write calls, set `version`, download the Linux x86_64 tarball yourself, compare `shasum -a 256` with the release's checksums.txt, paste that value into `sha256`, check `catalog` still exists in the new release (a new version may rename it), run the workflow from a pull request, and update config/pvtr-baseline.json for any control whose result changed.
